title: feat(cloud-connection)!: the marketplace catalog list filters by taxonomy facets on the server, and retires ?category=
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XHJo3uQpXK1vctgUQNzvpkw)_

Fixes #31173

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the facets are declared by the published `MarketplaceSearchRequestSchema`; refusing the retired `?category=` filter, and a facet the catalog cannot answer, narrows what the proxy honours
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` describes the query of `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages` (a `git grep` for `category=` and `marketplace/packages` there finds none); the generated `references/marketplace/marketplace.mdx` already lists the facet keys from the schema, and nothing in it moves

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:市场目录列表 `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages` 现在在服务端按职能(`businessFunctions`)、行业(`industries`)、解决方案类型(`solutionTypes`)和成熟度(`maturity`)筛选,同一维度内取「或」、维度之间取「与」,再在服务端分页;旧的 `?category=` 筛选删除,带它的请求回 400,并附上规格里退役该键时给出的改法(改用哪个维度)。
- 为什么改:控制台要按三个维度筛几百个模板,只拉 100 条在前端筛不动(#31011 第 5 项、#30904 裁决 §6);`?category=` 在 cloud#3661 去掉该列后会静默失效。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `@objectstack/cloud-connection` 一个文件加一个测试,patch 级;`?category=`、拼错的维度值、重复的维度键、空维度现在回 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`,仓内没有任何调用方发这些参数;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts` 的 `readCatalogListQuery`(拒绝规则,含 `category`)与 `catalogRowMatches`(或/与、缺省值),再看 handler 里在 R2 与 cloud 两条路之前读查询的那一段。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-proxy-browse-only.test.ts`,预期 16 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts`, the catalog list door `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages` (and `HEAD`):

- **The facets, the spec's spelling.** `businessFunctions`, `industries`, `solutionTypes` (plural, each a list) and `maturity` (one value), the keys `MarketplaceSearchRequestSchema` declares in `@objectstack/spec/marketplace`. A facet is ONE comma-separated value, `?businessFunctions=sales,marketing`, the spelling the platform's other list-valued query parameters take (`names` on the `/meta` list, `fields` / `searchFields` on the data routes); each value trimmed, blanks dropped, repeats folded. The allowed values are read from the spec schemas' `.options`, never copied.
- **OR within, AND across.** A row passes a facet when it carries any selected value; facets AND with each other, with `maturity` and with `q`. Rows are the catalog's own (snake_case `business_functions`, `industries`, `solution_type`, `maturity`, the columns objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 adds and #31011's console reads). A row with no `solution_type` counts as the spec's default `app` (`DEFAULT_SOLUTION_TYPE`) and one with no `maturity` as `stable`, the spec's reading of an absent key and the console's (`effectiveSolutionType` on PR #31187). A row without the facet columns passes no business-function or industry filter, so until the cloud serves the taxonomy those two facets return nothing, as #31011 plans.
- **Paged on the server.** On the public snapshot path the proxy filters the whole snapshot, then `limit` / `offset` page it (`limit` 1–100, default 50, as before) and `total` counts every match.
- **`?category=` retired, and refused.** The `category` branch is gone. A `category` parameter is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with the spec's own prescription, `retiredCategoryGuidance('MarketplaceSearchRequest.category')` from `@objectstack/spec/marketplace`: the text a parse of `MarketplaceSearchRequestSchema` gives the same retired key (migration entry `18.marketplace-category-retired`), naming the facets to send instead. No second spelling is kept, and a caller still filtering by category is told so instead of receiving the whole catalog.
- **Refused, before either path is asked**, `400` with the proxy's `{ success: false, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message } }`: `category` (above), a value the spec does not declare for the facet (`?businessFunctions=crm`, `?maturity=preview`), a facet or `maturity` supplied twice (`?industries=retail&industries=logistics`, the shared `repeatedQueryParamMessage`), and a facet naming no value (`?solutionTypes=`). The read sits in the handler ahead of the R2 fast path and the cloud path, so the answer does not depend on which one serves the list.

## Tests

The catalog pins live in the proxy's existing harness, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-proxy-browse-only.test.ts` (its `captureHandler` and `fakeCtx`, plus a stubbed `fetch`), 13 new beside its 3: OR within a facet, AND across, the `app` / `stable` defaults, rows without the taxonomy, folded values, `q` plus server paging (`total`, `limit`, `offset`), `?category=` refused with the spec prescription alone, beside a real filter and on the cloud-only configuration, each facet refusal on the R2 configuration and on the cloud-only one with no fetch made, and the cloud path forwarding the facet query verbatim.

<details><summary>Suites and ablations</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test`: on head `868cfd7e` (in the dogfood chain, under the lock), Test Files 73 passed (73), Tests 952 passed (952). `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `tsconfig.test.json`, which compiles the test): exit 0 on `868cfd7e`.
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed implementation (`868cfd7e`), each anchor hit once, each restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The suite imports the plugin from `src/` relatively, so no build sits on the path.
  - A1, the `category` refusal disabled (red-first for the retargeted pins): both `?category=` cases red, `expected undefined to be 400`, 2 failed / 14 passed.
  - A2, the undeclared-value refusal disabled: 2 failed / 14.
  - A3, the repeated-key refusal disabled: 1 failed / 15.
  - A4, the empty-facet refusal disabled: 1 failed / 15.
  - A5, OR within a facet turned into every-of: 3 failed / 13.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Card vs spec spelling.** The card writes `solutionType`; the spec's request schema declares `solutionTypes` (a list, like the other two facets). The door implements the declared spelling only; `?solutionType=` is ignored like any parameter the door does not read (the proxy refused no query parameter before this change, and `category` is the one retired key it now refuses). `solutionType` (singular) is the listing's own key, not a filter.
- **The cloud path.** With no `OS_MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` (the default: `resolveMarketplacePublicBaseUrl` returns empty when it is unset) every list request takes the cloud path, which forwards `pathname + search` to the control plane unchanged once the query passes the door (pinned by the last test). Whether the cloud filters by these names is the cloud's: NOT MEASURED here, reason: objectstack-ai/cloud is not readable from this session. Until it does, the console's switch-over sees server filtering only where the public snapshot path is configured.
- **The request schema is not this route's whole query.** `MarketplaceSearchRequestSchema` also declares `query` / `page` / `pageSize`, while this door (and the console, and the cloud route it proxies) speak `q` / `limit` / `offset`, and the list answers the catalog's row shape, not `MarketplaceSearchResponseSchema`. This PR takes only the facet keys and values from the schema and leaves the paging names as they were.
- **Kept as before.** `?limit=abc` still reads `NaN` and answers an empty page on the snapshot path (`limit: null` on the wire): unchanged here, not in this card. The console switch-over to the server parameters is the `domain:ui` follow-up the card names.

## Verification

Gate union derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (60 families), run after a full `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2` (VERDICT command-exit 0), each exit code captured before any pipe:

- **60 run, exit 0 each.** `--ran`: "60 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876` for its fixture on this shallow clone.
- **Full dogfood battery** (the `(narrowing)` arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock on `868cfd7e`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 435 passed, 3 skipped (438), Tests 3609 passed, 41 skipped (3650).
- `pnpm lint` scoped: `eslint --no-inline-config` over the two touched source files, exit 0.
